'''Guzerre''' was an aging [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who operated a small medical center in the caverns on [[Streysel Island]] on the resort world of [[Vaynai/Legends|Vaynai]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
